text:
Ari: Heads up 10: SageBridge renewal flagged, usage down ~60% MoM and they're running a side-by-side eval. Need triage. :warning:

OpsBot: alert | account=SageBridge | metric=usage_drop_30d | drop_pct=60 | severity=medium

Noah: Embedding calls are the culprit. Search traffic dropped. Gen endpoints steady. Competitor trial started 2026-03-02.

Sonal: Procurement swapped contact last week; Jade is the new procurement lead. Champion (data eng) is quieter after PoC.

Jade: Confirmed. We're evaluating a vendor bundling embeddings+analytics. Cost is main ask. Not cancelling yet.

Noah: Technical quick wins: prefix caching + 8-bit quantized embed model. Also can batch queries to reduce calls.

Ari: Proposed plan: 1) 30-day Dedicated pilot with token caps + audit logs, 2) runbook + cost breakdown, 3) enablement demo for their eng team.

Sonal: I'll prepare a short cost comparison and playbook. ETA Monday EOD.

Jade: Please include expected latency for embed queries. Our SLA target is p95 <200ms for interactive search.

Noah: Dedicated pilot can meet p95 <200ms with prefix caching and appropriate instance size.

Ari: Action owners added in Gainsight as At-risk 1-active mitigation. Noah/Sonal/Jade to present in Tue meeting.

Jade: Tue 10am PT works for procurement. Invite accepted.

Sonal: I'll post runbook draft in #cs-playbooks when ready.

Ari: Thanks team. If we can demo cost savings live, that should stall the churn. :thumbsup:
